title: pvPVTrivialProducer
body:
## pvPVTrivialProducer

ParaView's trivial producer (vtkPVTrivialProducer) wraps an existing data object and can also report time steps and a whole extent for structured data split across processes. As with pvTrivialProducer, the data must be attached by native code, which Schemaxis input cannot do, so it is not a useful authoring operation.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Schemaxis has no authored way to hand a dataset to a trivial producer, so the node is expected to produce an empty output; this has not been run.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PVTrivialProducer`. Identity: `sources/PVTrivialProducer`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `WholeExtent` | The values of this property specify the whole extent of the topologically regular grid. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvPVTrivialProducer"
}
```
